text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The title of Umamusume of the Year is<n>a great honor
bestowed on the<n>Umamusume who shines
brightest in<n>the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In order to bring happiness to a great<n>number of
people, Taiki Shuttle<n>resolves to seize this crown for
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thus begins her spirited sprint toward<n>a grand
dream!
